tools.name: search_scams
tools.description: Search the ScamNav anti-scam knowledge base by keyword across titles, summaries, tags and scam types. Returns matching cases in the requested language.

tools.name: get_scam_case
tools.description: Retrieve one scam case by slug, including sections and FAQs, in the requested language. Use search_scams first to find a slug.

tools.name: check_scam_risk
tools.description: Analyze a suspicious message, email or text for known scam red flags using deterministic rules. Returns a risk level (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL) and the matched warning signs.

tools.name: list_scam_types
tools.description: List all distinct scam types currently covered in the knowledge base.

tools.name: get_reporting_resources
tools.description: List official scam/cybercrime reporting channels. Optionally filter by region code. Only official authorities are included; no recovery or fund-recovery services.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_scam_risk · Public sink: check_scam_risk.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_scam_risk · Public sink: check_scam_risk

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
